releases.releaseName: Shing Live v1.3.3 - Authentic Petpetgif.com Hand Animation for Headpat Overlay
releases.summary: Updated the Pet-Pet Headpat overlay and dashboard preview to use the authentic 10-frame petpetgif.com patting hand sprite animation.
highlights: Authentic Petpetgif.com Hand Sprites: Replaced vector hand drawing with the original 10-frame pet0.gif-pet9.gif hand sprite animation from petpetgif.com
Exact Pet-Pet Squish Physics: Implemented the exact 10-frame petpetgif.com width/height/offset squish formula on the viewer TikTok profile picture
Instant Update Detection: Added uncached GitHub Contents API fallback alongside raw.githubusercontent.com so new updates are detected immediately without CDN delay
releases.notes: Authentic petpetgif.com hand animation for Pet-Pet Headpat overlay.

releases.releaseName: Shing Live v1.3.2 - Top Likers, Viewer Stay Ranking, Pet-Pet Headpat & Custom Media Triggers
releases.summary: Added standalone Top Likers, Viewer Stay-Time Ranking, and Pet-Pet Headpat overlays, custom Video/Photo/GIF alert media on Follow and Gift triggers, and a Universal Master Volume bar in the top header.
highlights: Top Likers Ranking Overlay (toplikers.html): Standalone leaderboard showing who sent the most likes on stream (default Top 3, configurable 1-10)
Viewer Stay Ranking Overlay (viewerranking.html): Tracks longest viewer stay time; stops timer on leave and resets current session timer to 00:00 on return while keeping Best Time
Pet-Pet Headpat Overlay (headpat.html): Animated Pet-Pet hand patting the viewer TikTok profile picture on Follow or Gift events
Custom Video / Photo / GIF Alerts: Upload custom MP4/WebM/MOV videos or GIF/PNG/JPG/WebP images for Follow and Gift alerts in the Triggers tab
Universal Master Volume & Clean Header: Removed the top Test Events bar and added a Universal Master Volume slider + mute toggle across all overlays
releases.notes: Top Likers, Viewer Stay Ranking, Pet-Pet Headpat, Trigger Video/Photo/GIF Media, and Universal Volume.

releases.releaseName: Shing Live v1.3.1 - Manual TikTok Live Connect & Disconnect Controls
releases.summary: Added a dedicated manual Connect button in the top header and Settings tab so streamers can connect, reconnect, or disconnect their TikTok Live stream anytime.
highlights: Header Connect Button: Added a prominent Connect / Connected / Reconnect button and quick Disconnect button in the top navigation bar
Settings Live Connection Card: Added real-time connection status badge, direct username editing, and Connect Live / Disconnect controls in App Settings
Race-Safe Connection Handshake: Added immediate Connecting state feedback, 15-second connection timeout protection, and toast notifications for manual connect results
releases.notes: Manual TikTok Live Connect and Disconnect button controls.

releases.releaseName: Shing Live v1.3.0 - TikTok LIVE Studio Link Source Compatibility Fix
releases.summary: Fixed TikTok LIVE Studio Add Link URL validation and File Not Found errors when adding .html overlay URLs.
highlights: TikTok LIVE Studio Link Compatibility: Updated Copy URL buttons to include .html extension required by TikTok LIVE Studio URL validator
Overlay Route Resolution: Updated OverlayServer to serve both /overlays/<name> and /overlays/<name>.html with HTTP 200 OK instead of 404 File Not Found
releases.notes: Resolves Enter correct URL and File Not Found in TikTok LIVE Studio Add link modal.

releases.releaseName: Shing Live v1.2.9 - Automatic Startup Updates & Persistent Theme Storage
releases.summary: Added automatic update installation when the software opens and moved user configuration storage to AppData so themes and settings never reset across updates.
highlights: Auto-Update on Startup: Automatically downloads and installs available updates when Shing Live is opened without requiring manual update checks
Persistent Theme & Settings Storage: Moved settings.json and backups to user-writable AppData with localStorage theme synchronization so custom themes never reset on update or restart
Seamless Legacy Migration: Automatically migrates existing settings from the installation directory on first launch
releases.notes: Automatic startup updater and permanent user theme persistence.

releases.releaseName: Shing Live v1.2.8 - Companion Card Stage Scaling & Update Modal Alignment
releases.summary: Fixed companion card preview canvas squishing when switching tabs, prevented speech bubble top clipping in compact previews, and centered the update confirmation modal icon.
highlights: Companion Card Preview Fix: Guarded canvas resize against hidden display:none tab dimensions so the chibi streamer and cats never collapse to 1px
Speech Bubble Viewport Clamping: Added compact stage scaling and top boundary clamping so speech bubbles never get cut off at the top of the card
Update Modal Alignment: Centered the checkmark badge and typography inside the Update Ready to Install confirmation dialog
Instant Post-Update Refresh: Automatically refreshes embedded preview iframes and version badges immediately after applying an update
releases.notes: UI layout and companion stage preview stability update.

releases.releaseName: Shing Live v1.2.7 - 1-Minute Companion Cat Meow Interval
releases.summary: Set companion cat meow interval to strictly once per minute and disabled automatic cat meows on gift, follow, chat, and like events.
highlights: 1-Minute Cat Meow Timer: Unified companion cat meowing to a single shared 60-second timer across all active cats
Event Meow Suppression: Cats no longer meow when viewers send gifts, follow, like, or chat
Silent Dashboard Card Preview: Muted miniature Overlays tab companion preview iframe so background tabs never duplicate audio
releases.notes: Companion audio refinement for a calmer, predictable 1-minute cat meow cadence.

releases.releaseName: Shing Live v1.2.6 - Reliable TikTok Live Auto-Connect & Protocol Upgrade
releases.summary: Upgraded TikTok Live WebSocket connector to latest v2.5.0 protocol, resolved EulerStream signing failures, and implemented resilient auto-connect with instant live detection.
highlights: Protocol Upgrade: Migrated from legacy v1 to modern TikTokLiveConnection v2.5.0 protocol architecture
Live Stream Auto-Connect: Fixed dead signing endpoints (EulerStream 403/404) that previously prevented the app from connecting to active streams
Background Polling: Zero-friction auto-connect that automatically monitors and locks onto the stream the instant the streamer goes live
Full Message Parsing: High-reliability parsing for chat comments, gifts, likes, joins, follows, and shares with comprehensive attribute fallbacks
Graceful Error Recovery: Clean disconnect handling, memory leak prevention, and automated 10-second polling retry loops
releases.notes: Critical network and connection engine update restoring seamless TikTok Live streaming integration.

releases.releaseName: Shing Live v1.2.5 - Biggest Gift Spotlight, Overflow Physics & Jar Visuals
releases.summary: Enhanced glass jar overlay with crisp high-contrast signature typography, overflow containment, clean transparent gift silhouettes, and Top Gifter spotlight badge.
highlights: Biggest Gift Spotlight: Replaced total count pill with real-time Top Gifter MVP badge highlighting the sender of the biggest stream gift
Overflow Physics: Added outer containment walls and floor so overflowing gifts tumble over the rim and cascade down the glass without despawning
Clean Gift Artwork: Removed artificial circular shadow discs so transparent gifts (galaxy spirals, roses, custom icons) render with natural silhouettes
High-Contrast Glass Typography: Re-crafted the shing cursive signature with pure white luminous fill, deep plum outline, and lavender halo for 100% legibility
releases.notes: Visual enhancement and physics upgrade for the Physics Gift Jar overlay.

releases.releaseName: Shing Live v1.2.4 - Live Animated Overlay Demo Loops & Real-time Settings Sync
releases.summary: Live animated demo loops for all 6 browser overlay cards with instant settings synchronization and zero idle CPU usage.
highlights: Live Animated Demo Loops: Replaced static badges with animated preview loops across all 6 overlay cards (Gift Jar, Companion Cats, Cute Chat, Lower 3rd Socials, Popup Alerts, Stream Timer)
Real-Time Theme Sync: Live demo feeds immediately reflect customized themes, colors, bubble radius, and avatar shapes as you modify them
Companion Stage Preview: Sandboxed companion iframe displaying pixel art chibi, walking cats, and interactive stage animations
Zero Background Overhead: Intelligent tab visibility detection that halts all animations when switching away from Overlays tab
Stream-Ready Countdown: Real-time digital clock with dynamic increment animations
releases.notes: Interactive visual overlay preview upgrade for TikTok Live streamers.

releases.releaseName: Shing Live v1.2.3 - Smooth In-App Toasts & Custom Pastel Alert Modals
releases.summary: Replaced native blocking alert dialogs with sleek floating pastel toast notifications and branded custom in-app modal cards.
highlights: Floating Toast Notifications: Smooth non-blocking notifications for settings save confirmations (chat, triggers, lower third, companion, jar, timer)
Custom Pastel Alert Modal: Elegant in-app dialog card replacing Win32 OS dialogs
Auto-Dismiss Progress Bar: 3-second auto-dismiss with countdown bar and manual close button
Zero Native Dialogs: Global window.alert override ensuring consistent streaming experience
releases.notes: Streamer dashboard UX upgrade eliminating disruptive native alert popups.

releases.releaseName: Shing Live v1.2.2 - Chat Overlay Themes & Stream Auto-Polling
releases.summary: 8 custom visual themes for the cute speech bubble chat overlay with live preview syncing and stream auto-polling reconnect.
highlights: Chat Overlay Themes: 8 themes (Pastel Purple, Dark Cyber Neon, Strawberry Milk, Matcha Latte, Sunset Peach, Frosted Glass, Midnight Dark, Retro Arcade)
Live Dashboard Sync: Real-time visual updates in settings tab when switching themes
Automatic Stream Polling: Background reconnect loop for streamers launching before starting live stream
TikTok Profile Avatars: Reliable profile picture extraction directly from live streams
releases.notes: Visual chat theme customization and streamer connection improvements.

releases.releaseName: Shing Live v1.2.1 - Companion Cat Meow Audio & 20s-30s Timer
releases.summary: Cats now reliably meow every 20s to 30s with cute audio sound effects, speech bubble, and hearts.
highlights: Cat Meow Interval: Configured cats to meow every 20s or 30s (20000ms - 30000ms)
Audio Sound Effect: Embedded authentic meow sound effect that plays whenever cats meow
Interactive Meowing: Clicking any companion cat triggers immediate meowing with floating hearts
Stream Trigger Integration: Cats meow and play sound on incoming gifts, follows, and chat messages
Dashboard Test Button: Added Test Cat Meow button in companion settings

releases.releaseName: Shing Studio v1.2.0 - Stream Sound Effects & 500 Gift Physics Jar
releases.summary: Full sound effects suite with MyInstants online search, local audio import, 500 gift physics jar, and support for all TikTok gift icons.
highlights: Full Sound Effects System: Alert sounds for Follows, Gifts, Big Gifts (1,000+ coins), and Likes with master volume control
MyInstants Online Search: Live search, instant audio preview, and one-click download with automatic alert assignment
Local Sound Import: Support for importing custom .mp3, .wav, .ogg, and .m4a audio files from local computer
All TikTok Gifts Display: Fixed gift icon visibility with catalog resolution and 3D shiny glass coin rendering
500 Gifts Jar Capacity: Increased default max gifts from 150 to 500 with smooth physics stacking
releases.notes: Major audio and gift visual upgrade for TikTok Live streamers.

releases.releaseName: Shing Studio v1.1.0 - Viewer Display Names & Coins HUD
releases.summary: Full viewer display name support, accurate TikTok coin currency HUD, and in-app update manager.
highlights: Viewer Display Names: Overlays now display viewers' customized nicknames instead of username handles
TikTok Coins Currency: Standardized all alert badges and jar physics from Diamonds to Coins
Chat Message Cap: Added configurable maximum visible messages limit (default: 8 messages)
6 Chibi Hair Styles: Twintails, Long, Bob, High Ponytail, Space Buns, Half-Up with custom color palettes
In-App Updater: Built-in update checker, one-click installer, and release notes history
Offline Live Mode: Graceful test mode simulation with gift catalog mappings
releases.notes: Recommended update for all TikTok Live streamers.

releases.summary: Initial release of Shing Studio for TikTok Live streamers.
highlights: Account verification modal with avatar and bio preview
Matter.js 2D physics glass jar overlay for TikTok gifts
Cute speech bubble chat overlay with animated avatar shapes
Pixel art chibi and cat companion interactive stage reactions
Multi-tier triggers and alert overlays for follows, gifts, and likes
Lower third animated banner for social links
Pastel purple theme with 6 customizable color themes
